summary: Click Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a memorandum of understanding (MOU) between its Care U senior-care brand and Weipu, a Qingdao elderly-nursing network affiliated with Hong Kong Baixiangyuan Elderly Care Consulting Limited. The MOU establishes a channel to roll out Care U home-nursing services in Shandong Province, starting in Jimo District. No deal terms, prices, or share transactions are disclosed. The announcement is a routine business and operational update, not a special situation. What to watch: execution of the MOU and impact on future revenues.
